# find_in_page

An in-app find bar for Flutter. Wrap your page and Ctrl+F highlights and scrolls to every match, in text you never wrapped and in lazy-list rows that were never built.

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/find_in_page
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/find_in_page
demo: https://yusufihsangorgel.github.io/find_in_page/

## Before you call it

AGENTS.md in the repository root is written for you. It carries the contracts that are easy to get wrong — scope placement, controller ownership, the post-layout first search, lazy-list registration and highlight rendering, and the web shortcut's limits — along with the shortest correct usage taken from the live example.

It also says what the package deliberately cannot search or reveal. Read those limits before adding the dependency.

## Layout

- `lib/find_in_page.dart` — public exports; `lib/src/` — implementation
- `example/` — runnable app and source of the live web demo
- `test/` — regular suite: `flutter test --exclude-tags demo`; the `demo`-tagged capture is opt-in
